caption: The drawing features a circular object centrally placed on a light beige background. Inside the circle, a stylized bird, likely an eagle, is depicted in profile facing left with a curved beak and a pattern of stripes on its neck and wings. The body and wings of the bird are formed with repeated linear and triangular shapes creating a feathered appearance. Two symmetrical leafy branches rise along the left and right inner edges of the circle, framing the bird. Below the bird, a series of geometric, radiating leaf or feather shapes fill the lower portion of the circle. The drawing is executed in shades of gray and black, with shading used to convey depth and texture. Below the central circle, a thin, straight line extends horizontally with small vertical tick marks and numerical labels, serving as a scale in inches. The entire composition is contained within a larger rectangular boundary.
title: Pa. German Butter Stamp
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
